entities.name: Serra Paladins
entities.description: Order of knights devoted to protecting Aysen and destroying Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire lord, nemesis of the paladins at Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Ihsan
entities.description: Most infamous paladin, who asked Sengir for immortality and was turned into a shade.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure whose point of view the paladins embody.

entities.name: Castle Sengir
entities.description: Baron Sengir's castle amid the mists of Koskun Falls.

events.summary: Ihsan goes to Castle Sengir to ask Sengir to make him immortal in order to kill him.
events.quote: went directly to the castle to ask the vampire lord to make him immortal

events.summary: Sengir sees through the plan and turns Ihsan into a shade unable to harm him.
events.quote: instead turned Ihsan into a shade, unable to harm him

events.summary: The paladins view this as betrayal and refuse to readmit Ihsan.
events.quote: The Serra Paladins viewed this as a betrayal

relations.quote: the ultimate destruction of Baron Sengir
The most infamous member of the order was Ihsan
devoted to the protection of the towns of Aysen
